# Portfolio C2 Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Bring the landing page at `/` up to `Portfolio C2.dc.html` — an Education section, a typing terminal strip, a road that starts at a Mesra gate with roadside scenery, richer hero ambience, section reveal, and a real motion pause control.

**Architecture:** The landing page is generated by `buildPortfolio()` in `tools/build-site.mjs`, styled by the `.pf-*` block of `tools/template/site.css`, and driven by `tools/template/portfolio.js`. C2 is an iteration on a page that already has the hero, mountains, sun, clouds and bus road — each task adds one scene element and its behaviour. Every ambient animation reads `animation-play-state: var(--amb, running)` so a single property pauses the whole page.

**Tech Stack:** Plain CSS, inline SVG emitted from Node ESM template literals, one vanilla-JS file. No framework, no build step for CSS.

## Global Constraints

- **Never edit `site/`.** It is build output. Edit `tools/` sources and rebuild.
- **Run the five gates before claiming any task done:**
  ```bash
  node tools/check-dsa.mjs
  python3 tools/check-python.py
  cd tools && node render-diagrams.mjs && node build-site.mjs && cd ..
  node tools/check-site.mjs
  ```
- **`git status --porcelain` must be empty when work is finished.**
- **The repo's copy beats the design's copy.** `Portfolio C2.dc.html` is a prototype whose content has fallen behind. Do **not** copy its Projects (it lists `litellm-rust` / `kafka-poc`; the repo ships `music-decoder` / `YTRecommender`), do **not** shorten the job descriptions in `PF_STOPS`, and do **not** hardcode the Notes counts (it says 122/615; the build interpolates live values). Only the **Education** copy is new and taken verbatim.
- **Tokens beat literals.** The design inlines hexes this codebase has tokenised. Use `var(--ink)`, `var(--acc)`, `var(--sky)`, `var(--paper)`, `var(--ink-2)`, `var(--mut)`, `var(--prose)`, `var(--cut)`, `var(--lift)`, `var(--lift-hi)`. In particular the design writes `#6B7C96`, which is **4.24:1 on white and fails AA**; `--mut` is `#4F5F79` for exactly that reason.
- **Yellow `#FFD808` is never text** — fill behind ink only.
- **Every ambient animation** must carry `animation-play-state: var(--amb, running)`.
- Inline SVG colours that are genuinely scene paint (mountain greys `#8C97AB` / `#A6B0C2`, pine greens `#2E7D46` / `#3C9159`, glass `#BEE3F8`) stay as literals — they exist only inside the illustration and are not part of the token system.

## Task 1: Motion control

Everything later in the plan animates, so the pause mechanism lands first. WCAG 2.2.2 requires a way to stop motion that starts automatically, runs over five seconds and sits alongside other content — C2's ambience is infinite, so this is a conformance requirement, not a preference.

**Files:**
- Modify: `tools/build-site.mjs` (hero nav), `tools/template/site.css` (`.pf-*` block), `tools/template/portfolio.js`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `--amb` on `body.portfolio`, values `running` | `paused`. Every later task's animations must read `animation-play-state: var(--amb, running)`. Also produces the button `#pf-motion` with class `.pf-motion`, and the `localStorage` key `pf-motion` holding `"paused"` or `"running"`.

- [ ] **Step 5: Wire the toggle in portfolio.js**

Prepend to `tools/template/portfolio.js`, above the existing bus driver:

```js
// Ambient motion switch. C2's scene loops forever — sun, clouds, snow, gondola,
// kite, rabbit, windmill, duck — so WCAG 2.2.2 wants a way to stop it. Every
// looping animation reads --amb, so one property parks the whole page.
(() => {
  const btn = document.getElementById('pf-motion');
  if (!btn) return;
  const body = document.body;
  const reduced = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');

  function apply(state) {
    body.style.setProperty('--amb', state);
    const paused = state === 'paused';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(paused));
    btn.querySelector('.pf-motion-icon').textContent = paused ? '▶' : '⏸';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', paused ? 'Resume background motion' : 'Pause background motion');
    // The gondola, the rabbit and the duck ride <animateMotion>, which is SMIL —
    // animation-play-state cannot reach it, but every <svg> root can pause its
    // own timeline. Without this the toggle would stop most of the scene and
    // leave three things moving, which is worse than not offering it.
    document.querySelectorAll('svg').forEach((svg) => {
      if (typeof svg.pauseAnimations !== 'function') return;
      paused ? svg.pauseAnimations() : svg.unpauseAnimations();
    });
  }

  // A reduced-motion preference is not a preference we get to overrule, so the
  // stored choice is only consulted when the user has not asked for less motion.
  let state = 'running';
  if (reduced.matches) state = 'paused';
  else if (localStorage.getItem('pf-motion') === 'paused') state = 'paused';
  apply(state);

  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    state = state === 'paused' ? 'running' : 'paused';
    apply(state);
    try { localStorage.setItem('pf-motion', state); } catch (e) { /* private mode */ }
  });

  reduced.addEventListener('change', (e) => { if (e.matches) apply('paused'); });
})();
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Add the typing loop and the reveal observer to portfolio.js**

Append to `tools/template/portfolio.js`:

```js
// The prompt types one line, holds, deletes and moves to the next. Under a
// reduced-motion preference the first line is simply left standing.
(() => {
  const el = document.getElementById('pf-type');
  if (!el) return;
  if (matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;

  const msgs = [
    '$ ping knowledge.local — 64 bytes received: curiosity alive',
    '$ uptime — 9 years in production, 0 dropped packets',
    '$ whoami — technical lead by day, side-project gremlin by night',
  ];
  let m = 0, i = msgs[0].length, deleting = false, timer;

  function step() {
    const s = msgs[m];
    if (deleting) {
      i -= 3;
      if (i <= 0) { i = 0; deleting = false; m = (m + 1) % msgs.length; }
      el.textContent = msgs[m].slice(0, i) + '▌';
      timer = setTimeout(step, 24);
      return;
    }
    i++;
    if (i >= s.length) { el.textContent = s; deleting = true; timer = setTimeout(step, 2800); return; }
    el.textContent = s.slice(0, i) + '▌';
    timer = setTimeout(step, 42);
  }
  timer = setTimeout(step, 1600);
  // a background tab should not keep a 42ms timer alive
  addEventListener('pagehide', () => clearTimeout(timer));
})();

// Sections settle into place as they come up. One observer, and each section is
// released the moment it has been revealed.
(() => {
  const secs = document.querySelectorAll('main section');
  if (!secs.length || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;
  if (matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;

  secs.forEach((s) => s.classList.add('pf-reveal'));
  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach((e) => {
      if (!e.isIntersecting) return;
      e.target.classList.add('pf-shown');
      io.unobserve(e.target);
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });
  secs.forEach((s) => io.observe(s));
})();
```

```css
@keyframes pf-swayg { 0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-3deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(3deg); } }
@keyframes pf-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
@keyframes pf-hop { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 45% { transform: translateY(-9px); } }

/* SVG children rotate about their own box rather than the viewBox origin */
.pf-tree, .pf-reed, .pf-board, .pf-sails, .pf-hop, .pf-lamp {
  transform-box: fill-box; animation-play-state: var(--amb, running);
}
.pf-tree, .pf-reed { transform-origin: bottom center; animation: pf-swayg 6s ease-in-out infinite; }
.pf-tree-b { animation-duration: 7.4s; animation-delay: -2s; }
.pf-tree-c { animation-duration: 7.8s; animation-delay: -2.4s; }
.pf-tree-d { animation-duration: 7.2s; animation-delay: -1.6s; }
.pf-reed   { animation-duration: 5.6s; animation-delay: -1s; }
.pf-reed-b { animation-duration: 6.8s; animation-delay: -3s; }
.pf-sails  { transform-origin: center; animation: pf-spin 9s linear infinite; }
.pf-hop    { transform-origin: center; animation: pf-hop 1.1s ease-in-out infinite; }
.pf-board  { transform-origin: top center; animation: pf-swayg 4.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
.pf-lamp   { transform-origin: center; animation: pf-bob 3.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
/* The rabbit, the duck and the gondola ride <animateMotion>, which is SMIL and
   deaf to animation-play-state. portfolio.js pauses their SVG timelines instead.
   These selectors stay so the elements are addressable from the checks. */
.pf-rabbit, .pf-pond, .pf-gondola { animation-play-state: var(--amb, running); }
```

## Self-Review

**Spec coverage.** Education → Task 4. Terminal strip and typing → Task 3. Hero ambience → Task 2. Road/gate/scenery/stop percentages → Task 5. Section reveal → Task 3. Motion control → Task 1. Content-accuracy and token rules → Global Constraints, and Task 5 Step 4 repeats the "do not touch the copy" instruction where it is easiest to get wrong. Responsive → Task 5 Step 8. Verification → each task's gate run plus Task 5's audit.

**Two things the spec under-specified, now pinned.** SMIL `animateMotion` (gondola, rabbit, duck) is deaf to `animation-play-state`, so the first draft of this plan documented that as an accepted gap. That was the wrong call for a control whose entire purpose is WCAG 2.2.2 conformance — a pause button that leaves three things moving is worse than none. Task 1 now also calls `pauseAnimations()` on every `<svg>` root, which stops SMIL timelines, and a check asserts it. And the reveal's hiding class is applied by JavaScript rather than sitting in the stylesheet, so a reader without JS is never left with an invisible page; Task 3 Step 7 tests exactly that.

**Type consistency.** `--amb`, `#pf-motion`, `.pf-motion-icon`, `pf-motion` (storage key), `#pf-type`, `.pf-reveal`/`.pf-shown`, `.pf-gate`, `.pf-scenery`, `.pf-rabbit`, `.pf-mill`, `.pf-pond`, `.pf-sign` are used identically in the checks and the implementation steps. `pf-bob` is defined in Task 2 and reused by `.pf-lamp` in Task 5 — Task 5 depends on Task 2 for that keyframe, which the task order guarantees.

**No known gaps.** The toggle stops every moving thing on the page: fourteen CSS loops via `--amb`, and the three SMIL motions via `pauseAnimations()`.
